MC-001.gaps: No wit-bindgen generated bindings, canonical-ABI validation, cross-language conformance or generated docs (toolchain absent); security approval of the world set pending named reviewers.

MC-002.gaps: Engine is V8 via Node for core Wasm only (process-per-run, wall-time limit, no fuel/memory caps inside the engine); Component-model binaries refused; no Wasmtime binding, canonical ABI, multi-runtime tests; fs/net/http providers not yet bound into the engine import table.

MC-003.gaps: Windows handle-relative implementation absent (fails closed); FIFO/device special-file policy only via O_NOFOLLOW + type checks on read; independent static review pending.

MC-004.gaps: No expiry, persistence, reconciliation, serialization/migration; authoritative INV-42 service must implement the DescriptorTable interface.

MC-005.gaps: No policy simulation/dry-run tooling, no decision caching, policy bundles unsigned, independent tenant-isolation review pending.

MC-006.gaps: Shared-key HMAC is not production identity; no X.509/SPIFFE, key custody, revocation lists, channel binding or real TEE verifier. Fuzzing found and fixed a token-malleability defect (non-canonical base64).

MC-007.gaps: Accepted-socket inheritance, proxy semantics, UDP data path, race tests and platform matrix not done; not bound into guest ABI yet.

MC-008.gaps: Locale/timezone, cwd semantics, fd inheritance for spawned engine only partly (clean env passed to node), secret rotation.

MC-009.gaps: No timer/sleep API, no trusted-time dependency handling, side-channel review needs a human reviewer.

MC-010.gaps: FIPS mode and fork/snapshot reseed semantics are delegated to the OS; no dependency review sign-off.

MC-011.gaps: 12-bit generation counter wraps after 4095 reuses of one slot (documented residual risk T-10).

MC-012.gaps: Localization boundary not addressed; security review pending.

MC-013.gaps: asyncio reference only; not wired to engine pollables/futures; no fairness, partial-I/O or load tests.

MC-014.gaps: No distributed consistency / multi-node activation, approval gates, impact analysis or schema migration.

MC-015.gaps: No remote/WORM transport, checkpoint key rotation/custody, tenant-separated streams, access monitoring.

MC-016.gaps: No OTLP exporter, secure transport, dashboards, alert rules or runbook links (needs the org's observability stack).

MC-017.gaps: No priority classes, soft limits/burst, dynamic updates, memory-pressure limits inside the engine, operator overrides.

MC-018.gaps: No connection pooling, proxy semantics, retry policy, HTTP/2 controls; not bound to guest ABI.

MC-020.gaps: Only linux/x86_64/Python 3.11/Node 22 executed; Windows fs provider absent; ARM64/macOS unrun.
